meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已有小说导入标准项目结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有想整理成项目结构继续创作的小说
copy.tagline_en: Import your existing novel into a standard project structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a novel you want to organize into a structured project for further writing.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把已有小说(半成品或完本)反向解析成标准写作项目:先按篇幅自动分流,再生成大纲、角色设定、正文和追踪文件,供后续写作流程直接续写。
howto.when: 当你说“/story-import”、“导入小说”或“把我的书导进来”等导入类指令时,Claude 会启动导入流程。

say.text: /story-import,把《我的小说》文本导入成写作工程。
say.note: Claude 会先确认书名和篇幅,再开始拆解。

say.text: 把我的书导进来,我想接着写第 N 章。
say.note: 按篇幅分流,生成可续写的项目。

say.text: 反向解析这篇小说,做成能续写的结构。
say.note: 会先询问意图:要写作工程还是只要拆文库。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can reverse-engineer an existing novel (partial or complete) into a standard writing project: auto-routes by length, then creates outlines, characters, chapters, and tracking files for later continuation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "/story-import", "import my novel", or "bring my book in" or similar import commands.

say_en.text: /story-import, import my novel's text into a writing project.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the title and length, then starts analysis.

say_en.text: Bring my book in, I want to continue writing chapter N.
say_en.note: It routes by length and creates a writable project.

say_en.text: Reverse-parse this novel into a continuable structure.
say_en.note: Asks intent first: writing project or just analysis.
